subject: 1093年大理国市集摊棚（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. NEW image, ONE freestanding SMALL MARKET CANOPY STALL only, no building. Isolated game map sprite on genuine transparent RGBA background. Dali kingdom in1093. Exactly FOUR bare wooden poles supporting one rectangular plain TAN FABRIC CANOPY, a waist-high plank counter with a few unlabeled pottery jars and small tea baskets. Canvas canopy, NO roof tiles, NO walls, NO house or hall behind it. Empty open space visible through the stall. A flat thin beaten earth rectangle 3m east-west by2m north-south, corners readable. Orthographic isometric map view, camera yaw45 elevation30, 2:1 ground projection: left/front ground edge slopes +0.5, front/right edge -0.5, east-west edge1.5 times north-south edge. Front faces lower left. Natural realistic Song-era fabric, timber and earth materials, low-key restrained color. Light screen upper left and tiny contact shadow lower right. Center on1536x1024 transparent canvas with >=15% empty margin. No mountains, trees, landscape, scene background, floor outside footprint, gradient glow, people, writing, signs, borders, watermarks, modern objects.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚底座、旅游古城风格、裁切、透视汇聚
created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 已逐张view_image(detail=original)：主体完整可辨，无文字、水印、人或现代物，南门朝左下，左上光；灰瓦木构与本批材质一致（独立摊棚为布木）。原图有低alpha外缘，终图需扩透明余白。底面视角与占地比例仍有残差，未标精确通过，见点位和projection_review。历史细部待考。
